title: Orbits of $p$-Nilpotent Group Actions for Small Primes
summary: Let $G$ be a finite solvable group and $V$ be a faithful completely reducible $G$-module. We improve previous bounds for the sizes of defect groups of blocks of solvable groups through an improved bound on vector stabilizers of $p$-nilpotent groups. Specifically, if $G$ is 2-nilpotent and $2 \nmid |V|$, then there exists $v \in V$ such that $\mathbf{C}_G(v) \leq \mathbf{F}_4(G)$. Similarly, if $G$ is 3-nilpotent and $3 \nmid |V|$, then there exists $v \in V$ such that $\mathbf{C}_G(v) \leq \mathbf{F}_5(G)$.
